sentences.text: This review covers wellbore 15/9-F-12 on the Volve field in the Norwegian North Sea, written from general engineering knowledge without access to the field's data tables.
No numerical figures are stated in this review, because the values for depths, hole sizes, durations, and lost time could not be verified against the source records.
A section-by-section account of hole sizes, casing shoe depths, and drilled intervals for 15/9-F-12 should be taken from the verified section records before this review is relied upon.
Drilling rates, interruption hours, and lost-time shares by section should be read from the activity log and checked against the report data before any performance conclusions are drawn.
Any recurring non-productive time should be grouped by problem code, so that the dominant causes can be identified and carried into the planning of later wells in the same area.
The entry, spud, and completion dates, along with the report coverage, should be confirmed from the daily report index, since gaps or pre-spud flags affect the calculated span of operations.
Before final sign-off, the figures in this review should be regenerated from the field database and every quantity restated with its source, so that the end-of-well record is fully traceable.
